$comment: User grid area (shape of user_grid_fees.json) with a capacity charge (section 5b): a monthly price per kW of the highest quarter-hour import power, two bands split at 10 kW, minimum 2 kW (SNE-G-V, Netzebene 7). Placeholder prices, not taken from any SNE-T-V; the per-area values are published by the regulator. The house profile selects the area with netznutzung.area_id.
